title: FedEx Showcases How AI-Powered Logistics and Global Connectivity are Enabling Global Growth at the 9th China International Import Expo
summary: Helping businesses strengthen supply chain resilience and unlock international opportunities.
body_markdown:
**Shanghai, China, November 5, 2026** — Federal Express Corporation, one of the world’s largest express transportation companies, is showcasing how innovation, global connectivity, and supply chain expertise are helping businesses of all sizes succeed in an increasingly complex trade environment at **the 9th China International Import Expo (CIIE). Located in the Trade in Services Exhibition Area (Booth 2.2H C4-03),** the FedEx booth highlights the company’s innovation in smart logistics, sustainable operations, and specialized transportation solutions.


Visitors can explore an all-electric autonomous delivery vehicle and a green Earth-inspired art installation, showcasing the future of logistics and underscoring the company’s commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. Visitors can also learn about the company’s role in[transporting giant pandas between China and international destinations](https://newsroom.fedex.com/newsroom/asia-english/fedex-panda-express-delivers-giant-pandas-from-china-to-the-united-states-supporting-global-conservation-efforts)


, having safely transported 23 giant pandas to and from China to date. These same capabilities help customers move high-value and time-sensitive cargo, including advanced manufacturing equipment, healthcare products, and technology infrastructure that power the global economy.


The need for resilient supply chains and seamless access to international markets is becoming increasingly important. According to data released by the General Administration of Customs of China (GACC), China’s total goods trade reached RMB 39.94 trillion in the first three quarters of 2026, representing a year-on-year increase of 18.8%.\[1\] The strong growth highlights the value of trusted logistics partners, like FedEx, in helping businesses navigate an evolving global trade landscape.


“For more than four decades, FedEx has grown alongside China’s economy, helping global businesses access the Chinese market while connecting local enterprises to customers and opportunities around the world,” said Poh-Yian Koh, president of FedEx China. “As AI, digitization, and evolving supply chains reshape global commerce, businesses need more than transportation. They need trusted partners that can provide connectivity, visibility, and resilience. Through continued investments in our extensive global network, intelligent logistics solutions, and deep industry expertise, FedEx is helping businesses unlock new growth opportunities in the next era of international trade.”


At CIIE, FedEx demonstrates how it is helping businesses navigate a rapidly evolving global trade environment through investments in connectivity, innovation, sustainability, and entrepreneurship.


**Strengthening global connectivity**


FedEx continues to expand its network and service capabilities in China. Over the past year, the company strengthened connections between Guangzhou and key Asia-Pacific markets, including[Penang, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok](https://newsroom.fedex.com/fedex-expands-asia-network-with-launch-of-guangzhou-penang-flight-supporting-trade-growth-in-malaysia)


and[Sydney](https://newsroom.fedex.com/newsroom/asia-english/fedex-strengthens-intra-asia-connectivity-with-new-guangzhou-sydney-non-stop-freighter-service)


, and[signed a strategic cooperation memorandum with China Southern Air Logistics](https://newsroom.fedex.com/newsroom/asia-english/fedex-and-china-southern-air-logistics-sign-memorandum-of-understanding-on-strategic-cooperation)


to further enhance air cargo network capabilities. Together with specialized solutions for healthcare, cold chain logistics and e-commerce, these investments help businesses navigate increasingly complex global supply chains.


**Advancing digital and AI-enabled logistics**


As supply chains become more data-driven, FedEx is leveraging AI, automation, and digital technologies to improve visibility, efficiency, and reliability across cross-border logistics. From intelligent customs declaration capabilities and digital shipping solutions to[advanced automation technologies deployed at its East China facility](https://newsroom.fedex.com/newsroom/asia-english/fedex-upgrades-largest-station-in-east-china)


, FedEx is helping customers build smarter and more resilient supply chains. These capabilities also support the growing demand for AI infrastructure and data center development worldwide.


**Driving sustainable operations**


Sustainability remains a key focus of the company’s long-term strategy. In 2026, FedEx launched its[first solar power project in East China](https://newsroom.fedex.com/newsroom/asia-english/fedex-expands-renewable-energy-footprint-in-asia-pacific-withfirst-on-site-solar-installation-in-east-china)


and continued expanding vehicle electrification initiatives, including deploying[the Asia Pacific region’s first all-electric pickup-and-delivery fleet in Ningbo](https://newsroom.fedex.com/newsroom/asia-english/fedex-launches-its-first-all-electric-pick-up-and-delivery-fleet-for-daily-operations-in-asia-pacific-at-ningbo-station)


. Today, approximately one-third of the company’s vehicle fleet in China is electrified. Beyond its operations, FedEx also supports environmental initiatives such as[the “Protect One Kilometer of Riverways” program](https://newsroom.fedex.com/newsroom/asia-english/fedex-expands-2026-river-protection-initiative-in-collaboration-with-all-china-environment-federation)


and[the University Environmental Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition](https://newsroom.fedex.com/newsroom/asia-english/fedex-concludes-university-student-led-environmental-entrepreneurship-challenge)


, reinforcing its commitment to sustainable community development.


**Empowering entrepreneurs and SMEs**


FedEx continues to help small- and medium-sized businesses access global opportunities through reliable transportation services, end-to-end shipment visibility and flexible logistics solutions. Through initiatives such as[the FedEx Small Business Grant Contest](https://newsroom.fedex.com/newsroom/asia-english/fedex-celebrates-innovative-asia-pacific-startups-empowering-businesses-to-scale-through-its-small-business-grant-contest)


, the company supports innovative startups with funding, mentoring, and market development resources. This year, Chinese startup Linkerbot Intelligence received a Special Mention Award, highlighting the growing innovation capabilities and international potential of China’s entrepreneurial ecosystem.


As global trade continues to evolve, FedEx remains focused on helping businesses connect to opportunities across borders with greater speed, intelligence, and confidence. Through continued investments in innovation, global connectivity, and customer-centric solutions, FedEx is committed to supporting the Chinese market and helping businesses thrive in an increasingly interconnected world.


\[1\][General Administration of Customs of China (GACC), China’s Total Export & Import Values, Sep 2026(in CNY)](http://english.customs.gov.cn/Statics/22e23664-4ac7-4c03-80d8-27572ac63ff7.html)
